metadata.description: Product marketing ops skills for AI agents — prove impact, build sales content reps use, and run launches three teams agree on

plugins.name: pmm-ops-skills
plugins.description: Three product marketing ops skills plus a shared context file: a PMM impact tracker (targets, movement logs, call language, win/loss dollars, content-to-deal links, shared-metric splits, day 30/60/90 scorecards, quarterly impact story), a rep-ready content loop (rep needs interviews, content audits, 10-second cards, rep voice rewrites, freshness cycles, field feedback, launch-day sales kits, adoption scorecards), and a shared launch agreement (launch process map, kickoff agreement, positioning sign-off, claim source list, decision record, tie-break rule, day-30 consistency check, timeline review, business case)
